title: Report layer = §6.3 doc + det-only audit pipeline + 3 renderers, deterministic w/ injectable clock
rationale: trellis-59ea builds src/report/ as the per-run §6.3 surface: build.ts auditRepo is the surface-agnostic core pipeline (rubric→discovery→registry→detectors per app/repo→scoring→Report) that CLI+SDK fold; agent criteria short-circuit to no-detector('investigation layer not yet wired') BEFORE the registry (registry stays deterministic-only), repo-scope runs once at root w/ unioned languages, app-scope runs per app then aggregateAppScope. Renderers: json.ts (JSON.stringify insertion-order = determinism anchor), markdown.ts (PR scorecard), terminal.ts (human), sharing rollup.ts rollupByCategory/tally (renderers take the Rubric for category membership since Report.criteria carries none). Determinism: pipeline pure given (checkout,rubric,detectors); scoredAt is the ONLY wall-clock field, injectable via opts.now — two runs serialize byte-identically sans timestamp. CLI passes preloaded rubric into auditRepo+renderers to avoid double-load. Goldens under __golden__/ w/ TRELLIS_UPDATE_REPORT_GOLDEN gate.

title: History reporting: §11 delta in src/report/changes.ts, dashboard in src/history/, folded at audit time
rationale: trellis-dde8 splits §11 into a pure delta (report/changes.ts: changesSinceLastRun(current,previous Report) → per-criterion transitions pass-to-fail/fail-to-pass/na-kind/denominator/score/added/removed + netLevelMove, attribution code vs possibly-rubric by rubricVersion) and a SQLite-backed dashboard (src/history/: buildHistory + terminal/md renderers, JSON is the report itself, same thin-CLI pattern as fleet). changes.ts lives in report/ (not history/) to avoid a cycle: report/types.ts imports the ChangesSinceLastRun type, history/ imports report+store. auditRepo embeds the delta via opts.previousRun?: Report|null (fleet+audit CLI read store.latestRun then storedReport(run) to parse report_json back) and appends changesSinceLastRun LAST in the report object so JSON key order stays byte-stable and a first run omits the key. Store gained repos()/runs(repo,since?)/criterionTrend(repo,since?) + storedReport. Trends keep only criteria that moved. Watch file-size ratchet (400-line cap): split CLI report tests into src/cli/report.test.ts and trimmed build.ts.

title: Markdown FILE report renders full audit detail; terminal stays brief
rationale: trellis-89d6: src/report/markdown.ts now renders everything the audit graded (every criterion grouped by category with failing-first ordering, verdict/score/rationale, failing gate callout, canonical drift, changes-since-last-run), via a new projectCriteria() helper in rollup.ts that reuses criterionStatus/gateFails. Terminal renderer intentionally unchanged (brief banner + per-category table). JSON was already complete (JSON.stringify). Renderers stay pure projections; numbers come from rollup helpers so views never disagree.

title: Default audit report file anchors to the audited repo, not process.cwd()
rationale: trellis-c2af: planReportTarget anchored the default .trellis/ report dir to process.cwd(), so CLI/SDK tests spawning 'trellis audit <tempdir>' (no cwd, no --no-output) wrote timestamped audit-*.md into the REAL repo's gitignored .trellis/ (invisible pollution, N runs = N files since the filename is per-second). Fix: anchor the default dir to repoPath (a report about repo X belongs with repo X), and pass --no-output in tests that assert exit codes/output rather than artifacts. Test fixtures already rmSync their temp dir, so anchoring also self-cleans test reports.
